eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Nine
subtitle: Lesson 91 · Transactions, Locking, and Isolation Levels

eyebrow: Set per session, with one statement
caption: Isolation level is a dial: stricter means fewer anomalies, more blocking.

steps.label: NONREPEATABLE READ
steps.sub: the same row gives a different value twice

steps.label: PHANTOM READ
steps.sub: the same query returns a different set of rows

code:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;  -- loosest
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;     -- SQL Server's default
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;        -- strictest
caption: Each one down this list prevents more anomalies, at the cost of more blocking.

code:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SNAPSHOT;  -- session-level

ALTER DATABASE AdventureWorks2012
  SET READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT ON;          -- database-level (RCSI)
caption: Both use row versioning instead of locking for reads.
